fixture.purpose: numerical integration only; no policy capability claim

measurement_notes: Single and dual use the same global arguments, precision and initialization checkpoints.
Performance window: 10 warmup valid iterations, then 50 measured; whole jobs run 80 iterations.
Warp pool high-water includes warmup; PyTorch peaks reset at performance window start.
device_peak_used is sampled at iteration boundaries, not an instantaneous device-wide maximum.
local512 device_used is measured at checkpoint save, not a peak.
Synthetic short clips and test-specific learning/admission settings validate execution, not policy quality.
